_description: Requirement-level state tracking in a single file. Each sub-requirement independently tracks its status, blocker details, and resume target.

_status_meanings.draft: Newly created with uncertain boundaries - source_ref coverage, normalized statements, or dependencies are incomplete
_status_meanings.split_ready: Complete source_ref coverage, normalized statements, explicit scope, and dependencies - ready to enter the next stage
_status_meanings.acceptance_frozen: A CP-UI-authorized real host component, runtime coverage matrix, and official visual-scenario previews are frozen in the slice worktree; v2 contracts/ui-truth-index.json provenance, profiles, scenarios, coverage, paths, SHA-256 hashes, and preview-bound confirmations are valid (UI sub-requirements only; non-UI sub-requirements skip this state)
_status_meanings.spec_ready: spec.md has been generated and audited against the contract
_status_meanings.plan_ready: plan.md has been generated and audited against delivery-slice ordering
_status_meanings.tasks_ready: tasks.md has been generated with suitable task granularity, dependency ordering, and file-level scope - awaiting user confirmation to enter the remaining development work
_status_meanings.in_dev: Remaining implementation work is in progress - UI slices reuse the Stage 2 worktree and the TDD loop is active
_status_meanings.visual_acceptance_passed: The implementation passed every indexed visual/runtime scenario and structured visual-acceptance.json binds the current UI truth index (UI slices only; non-UI slices skip this state)
_status_meanings.merged: Code has been rebased and integrated into the development branch without a merge commit
_status_meanings.archived: Frozen archive - artifacts are snapshotted under archive/ with a MANIFEST.json and are immutable; requirement changes require a new <req-id>
_status_meanings.blocked_missing_requirement: The source lacks critical business facts
_status_meanings.blocked_requirement_conflict: Two approved sources conflict with each other
_status_meanings.blocked_dependency: An upstream sub-requirement is not ready
_status_meanings.blocked_missing_design: Required visual evidence is missing from the design
_status_meanings.blocked_requirement_figma_conflict: The requirement and visual truth conflict irreconcilably
_status_meanings.blocked_figma_conflict: Design evidence from different providers conflicts
_status_meanings.blocked_missing_state_code: The final screen state lacks structured framework evidence
_status_meanings.blocked_missing_visual_truth: The default state, row combinations, parent shell, or key assets are missing
_status_meanings.blocked_spec_mismatch: Official spec output conflicts with governance truth
_status_meanings.blocked_dependency_slice: An upstream slice has not been merged
_status_meanings.blocked_verification_failure: Tests, review, or visual acceptance still fail after automated fixes

_blocker_scope_meanings.slice_local: A blocker limited to one slice, stage, or capability surface. By default it must not block unrelated slices or stages.
_blocker_scope_meanings.action_level_integration: A blocker limited to real API wiring or final semantic closure for one action. It does not block visual mapping, shell work, local state work, navigation scaffolding, or safe read-only paths.
_blocker_scope_meanings.requirement_global: Pausing the entire requirement is allowed only when every currently derivable queue item is unrunnable. If any safe runnable item exists, the blocker is not requirement-global.

_checkpoints.CP-UI: ui_visual_implementation_authorization - a split_ready UI slice awaits user authorization to write the production component, golden tests, and preview in an isolated worktree
_checkpoints.CP-001: tasks_ready_user_confirmation - all executable slices have reached tasks_ready and await user confirmation to enter development
_checkpoints.CP-002: hard_blocker_pause - no safe runnable queue items remain for the current requirement; this checkpoint is allowed only when no runnable item exists
_checkpoints.CP-DESIGN: design_approval - the solution design must pass design review and receive user approval before entering the spec stage
_checkpoints.CP-ARCHIVE: archive_confirmation - all slices are merged and await user confirmation to freeze the immutable archive/ snapshots

_runtime_modes.bootstrap: status.json is missing or incomplete, or the queue cannot be derived safely - start from the first governed stage
_runtime_modes.resume: At least one unresolved or runnable queue item remains after reconciliation, and no checkpoint actively prevents execution
_runtime_modes.confirm_ui: current_checkpoint=CP-UI; a split_ready UI slice awaits user authorization for controlled visual implementation; NEXT_ACTION=none until confirmed
_runtime_modes.confirm_design: current_checkpoint=CP-DESIGN; runnable slices require design approval before entering the spec stage
_runtime_modes.confirm_to_dev: current_checkpoint=CP-001; all executable slices are tasks_ready and await user confirmation to enter development
_runtime_modes.blocker_recovery: current_checkpoint=CP-002; the user supplied the missing decision or the external blocker has cleared
_runtime_modes.closing: current_checkpoint=CP-ARCHIVE; all executable slices are merged and await user confirmation to freeze the archive
